title: India's logistics cost is 7.97% of GDP. Yours may not be.
takeaways: Logistics cost in India: 7.97% of GDP in FY2023-24.
Road costs ₹3.78 per tonne-km; rail costs ₹1.96.
Small firms spend 16.9% of output on logistics; large firms 7.6%.
Road carries 71% of freight; rail's target share is 45%.
Rail-road multimodal beats all-road beyond about 600 km.
